entities.summary: Aldo Weber Vieira da Rosa was a professor emeritus of electrical engineering at Stanford University. His research interests were in ionospheric processes, energy processes and renewable energy. He authored Fundamentals of Electronics (1989) and Fundamentals of Renewable Energy Processes (2005). His patent for the process for the production of ammonia expired in 1996.
